note: Guest bindings generators from WIT for C, C++, C#, D, Go, Rust and MoonBit; build-time tool, no runtime
WIT files specify imports and exports; the generator lowers them to flat Wasm signatures
No registry or distribution; tool only
No isolation of its own; isolation comes from the Wasm host
Not applicable to a bindings generator
Same guest crate also compiles for native targets with encoded export symbols; Wasm remains the portable form
Dependencies are expressed in WIT packages by the host toolchain; not examined in code
WIT and the Component Model define interface versions; code not read
